# Content Integrity Requirements Quality Checklist: Wayfinder self-assessment

**Purpose**: Validate single-source YAML requirements and the questions API source regression decision.
**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: Generated by /speckit-checklist. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Single Source

- [x] CHK041 Is every piece of text that must come from the YAML enumerated (statements, From/To, anchors, practical application, plan activities, week 6), with none left ambiguous? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK042 Is the requirement that the text "MUST NOT also be written out in the post's prose" verifiable, and is the way to detect duplication defined? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK043 Are schema constraints defined (counts of three statements and five shifts, unique anchors, nonempty fields, version field) with a named error for each? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-004, contracts/assessment-data.md]
- [x] CHK044 Is the heading-anchor link requirement consistent with how the post's headings get their ids, and what happens if the post heading changes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK045 Are requirements defined for reader-visible text reused "unchanged" (FR-008) versus rendered in the post (FR-004), so both views cannot diverge? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK046 Is the rule for when the statement-set version changes (any wording edit, only scoring-relevant edits) specified for Don as editor? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK047 Are no-JavaScript and printed-post renderings required to match the YAML content exactly? [Consistency, Spec Edge Cases]

## Questions API Source Regression

- [x] CHK048 Is the loss of the Practical Application and 6-Week Plan text from the questions API source stated as an accepted requirement change in the spec, not only in the plan and research R13? [Gap, plan Risks]
- [x] CHK049 Is the acceptance criterion for that regression defined (for example, questions still cover all five shifts from the remaining prose)? [Measurability, research R13]
- [x] CHK050 Does the spec state whether questions about plan activities are expected, given the panel's purpose of testing understanding of the post? [Ambiguity, Assumption]
- [x] CHK051 Is the effect of the changed source hash on cached question sets and token bucket cost (one regeneration, free-plan limits) captured as a requirement or assumption? [Dependency, research R13]
- [x] CHK052 Is the follow-up that would widen the source recorded in the spec's Follow-up work, with a trigger for doing it? [Traceability, Spec Follow-up work] (n/a: no follow-up needed; FR-021 keeps the question source complete in this slice, so there is nothing to widen later)
- [x] CHK053 Is the decision consistent with constitution Principle VI and the questions API rule that questions cover only the site's own posts? [Consistency]
